test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence to improve it. If no improvement is required, select ‘No improvement required’.

As bombs keep falling on Gaza, hundreds of thousands of children __have been order to flee__ their homes.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the second part of the given sentence, the plural form of the verb 'have been ordered' is correct.
 
• In the given sentence, the subject **'hundreds of thousands of children'** is **plural**.
 
• And this is a passive statement. So '**been**' is to be placed **only before V3 form **
 
• Therefore, the plural form of the verb 'have been ordered' is correct and should be used here. 

 

Hence, the correct statement is '*As bombs keep falling on Gaza, hundreds of thousands of children **have been ordered to flee** their homes*.'
